text:
Iris (PM): Quick heads-up: Ignite (hosted) is GA today. New endpoint /v3/ignite-stream supports streaming + Tool-Calling v3. Models: ignite-core and ignite-slim. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/ignite-ga :tada:

Marco (Eng): Will there be any wire-format changes?

Iris (PM): Yes 1 1 small change: framed JSON chunks and explicit tool_call frames. SDKs must be >=1.14.0. Were shipping a short-lived compatibility shim for v2 clients but recommend migrating ASAP.

release-bot: release pipeline: ignite/v1.0.0 -> canary(us-west) -> staged rollout. CI passed.

Dee (SRE): Ops notes: new metric ignite.stream_latency_p50 added. Fallback: route->ignite-slim on latency breach. If you see a sudden increase in 5xx, enable IGNITE_FALLBACK=true and notify #eng-oncall.

Marco (Eng): Any guidance on latency/cost?

Iris (PM): p50 improved for short-turn prompts (~20%) vs previous gen; cost roughly same when using kv_cache. Recommend batching_window=20ms and enable_kv_cache for repeated prefixes.

Hyejin (Docs): I'll publish a migration guide, quickstart, and sample toolcall walkthrough in 30m. I'll include a WebSocket + Python streaming example.

Iris (PM): Deprecation: /v2/ignite-sse deprecated for new sessions today; full shutdown planned 2026-10-01. Action items: Eng -> SDK release, Docs -> migration, SRE -> monitor canary. Ping me with customer exceptions. :rocket:
